items.prose: Thick, root-like water-conducting hyphal strands (rhizomorphs) of *Serpula lacrymans* bridged five meters of dry brick mortar joints from a leaking sump. The fungus transported moisture directly into dry floor joists, reducing structural load capacity to zero.

Persistent condensation under meat locker refrigeration coils maintained timber moisture at 52%. *Coniophora puteana* thoroughly digested the pine subfloor, causing severe longitudinal and cross-grain cubical cracking that collapsed under a fork truck.

A massive 60cm fleshy bracket fruiting body (sporophore) matured behind the air plenum wood framing, discharging billions of rust-red microscopic spores per hour. The airborne spore cloud choked electrostatic pre-filters and triggered respiratory asthma.

Halting an advancing dry-rot front required cutting back all infected wood one meter beyond visible hyphae and pressure-injecting a 5% zinc oxyquinoline fungicidal fluid into masonry mortar lines. The chemical barrier successfully contained the outbreak.

*Postia placenta* brown rot enzymes selectively metabolized holocellulose while modifying lignin into a friable brown residue. Timber stair stringers lost 70% of their cross-grain shear strength within six weeks while retaining normal dimensional shape.

Rain seepage through blast-damaged concrete roof slabs nourished *Trametes versicolor* colonies across the ash roof rafters. The fungus bleached the wood white and dissolved the structural lignin, turning dense hardwood into soft, fibrous sponge.

Installing un-vented polyethylene plastic sheeting over damp concrete sub-bases trapped moisture underneath. The warm 100% relative humidity microclimate fostered rapid soft rot decay, rotting forty linear meters of structural floor sills.
